lines.text: In Shittim, Moab's daughters invited Israel's men to sacrifices, and Israel worshiped Baal of Peor, so the LORD's anger burned.
The LORD ordered the leaders executed, and Moses told the priests to kill the men who worshiped Baal.
Phinehas drove a spear through an Israelite man and a Moabite woman, and the plague against Israel was halted.
The LORD said Phinehas was zealous for Him and granted him a covenant of peace and permanent priesthood.
The slain man was Zimri, the slain woman was Cozbi, and the LORD told Moses to attack the Midianites.
